name: Hassan Sheikh Mohamud
role: President, FGS (disputed) — term EXPIRED May 15; invoking disputed March 2026 amendments extending to 2027; opposition declared illegitimate May 16. June 4-5: government deployed heavy artillery in Mogadishu during worst urban warfare in decade — UN Guterres alarmed, US called for restraint; government claimed order restored June 5. Turkish F-16s flew over capital in apparent show of support. Opposition countdown Day 21 (9 days to Deni's parallel authority threat, June 14). SW State presidential vote June 10; Galmudug/Hirshabelle June 20. Adan Yabal Day 47 under Al-Shabaab. 4th piracy vessel reportedly hijacked June 5; 44 hostages still captive across 3 vessels. WFP July 2026 shutdown warning active.
quote: Security forces acted to protect constitutional order and prevent armed factions from seizing state institutions. The June 10 Southwest State election will proceed. We call on all Somalis to choose dialogue over the barrel of a gun — but the state will defend itself.

name: Ahmad Umar (Abu Ubaidah)
role: Emir of Al-Shabaab (since September 2014)
quote: The mujahideen will continue their operations until the foreign invaders and their apostate allies are expelled from every inch of Muslim land.

name: Mohamed Abdullahi 'Farmaajo'
role: Former President of Somalia (2017–2022)
quote: Security, reconciliation, and rule of law are the pillars upon which we will rebuild this nation.

name: Hamza Abdi Barre
role: Prime Minister of Somalia (appointed June 2022)
quote: The Macawisley mobilization shows that the Somali people themselves are rising up against Al-Shabaab's tyranny.

name: Ahmed Abdi Godane (Abu Zubayr)
role: Al-Shabaab Emir 2008–2014; killed in US airstrike Sept 2014
quote: We are fighting the enemies of Islam and their apostate agents. Our struggle will continue until the last crusader is expelled.

name: Lt. Gen. Sam Okiding
role: ATMIS Force Commander (Uganda)
quote: The transition to Somali-led security is on track. We are building capacity that will outlast our mission.

name: Ahmed Abdi Kariye (Ilka Jiir)
role: Former Mayor of Mogadishu; senior FGS official
quote: Mogadishu has been transformed. Those who left will return to a city that is rising from the ashes.

name: Ahmed Madobe
role: President of Jubbaland State (declared independent government May 31); co-leads Somali Future Council; treats SNA Gedo deployment as foreign incursion; Kenya's KDF is Jubbaland's external security anchor; rejects NIEBC calendar; June 4-5 Mogadishu urban warfare cited by Jubbaland as proof of Mohamud's authoritarian turn; opposition countdown Day 21 (9 days to June 14 deadline)
quote: The government's bombardment of Mogadishu's civilian neighborhoods confirms what we have said all along: this is not a president, it is an occupation. Jubbaland stands with the Somali people demanding their constitutional rights. June 14 approaches.

name: Laftagareen (Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed)
role: Former President of Southwest State; re-elected Mar 28, resigned Mar 30, 2026 as SNA seized Baidoa; resigned JSP party Mar 18, 2026
quote: The federal government's unconstitutional amendments and military deployments against Southwest State are a blatant invasion. We will not surrender our state's rights to a one-man show in Mogadishu.

name: Catriona Laing
role: UN Special Representative for Somalia / Head of UNSOM
quote: The ATMIS drawdown must be matched by genuine investment in Somalia's security forces. The international community must not abandon Somalia at this critical juncture.

name: Gen. Michael Langley
role: Commander, US Africa Command (AFRICOM)
quote: Our operations in Somalia remain focused on degrading Al-Shabaab's leadership and protecting US national security interests in the region.

name: Hassan Ali Khaire
role: Former Prime Minister of Somalia (2017–2019)
quote: Security sector reform is the foundation of everything. Without it, no political progress will be sustainable.

name: Said Abdi 'Shirdon'
role: Former Prime Minister; opposition figure
quote: Political reconciliation among all Somali factions must accompany military operations for any lasting peace.

name: Olgan Bekar
role: Turkish Ambassador to Somalia; key Turkish-Somalia bilateral coordinator
quote: Turkey's commitment to Somalia is long-term. We are here to help build lasting peace and prosperity for the Somali people.

name: Sheikh Mohamed Nur Gurhan
role: Macawisley (Clan Militia) Commander, Hiiraan Region
quote: Al-Shabaab levied taxes on our families, killed our elders, and recruited our children by force. We took up arms because we had no choice.

name: Fahad Yasin
role: Former National Intelligence and Security Agency (NISA) Director; influential political figure
quote: Intelligence-led operations are essential to dismantling Al-Shabaab's network. We must hit their financing and recruitment.

name: Said Abdullahi Deni
role: President of Puntland State; co-leads Somali Future Council opposition; declared Mohamud illegitimate May 16, 2026; opposition countdown Day 21 as of Jun 5 — 9 days remain before June 14 parallel authority deadline; June 4-5 Mogadishu urban warfare validates opposition warnings of government authoritarian slide; rejects NIEBC electoral calendar (SW State June 10 vote) as illegitimate; Jubbaland withdrawal (May 31) sustains federal fragmentation; Turkish F-16 flyover (Jun 5) seen as Ankara backing Mohamud militarily against opposition
quote: The government's use of heavy artillery against its own citizens in Mogadishu has answered the question of whether dialogue is still possible. We are proceeding with our constitutional roadmap. By June 14, Somalis will have a legitimate transitional authority to restore constitutional order.

name: Bankole Adeoye
role: AU Commissioner for Political Affairs, Peace and Security
quote: Africa must take the lead in securing Somalia. ATMIS and its successor mission represent the AU's commitment to durable peace in the Horn.

name: Adam Abdelmoula
role: OCHA Somalia Humanitarian Coordinator
quote: Nearly 7 million Somalis face acute food insecurity. The humanitarian community needs unimpeded access and sustained funding to prevent catastrophe.

name: Sheikh Sharif Sheikh Ahmed
role: Former President (2009–2012); former ICU moderate leader
quote: The path to peace in Somalia runs through dialogue with those who are willing to lay down arms and engage in the political process.
